definitionZh: 将对处理程序触发的所有事件运行 event.cancelable && event.preventDefault()。拖动链接或图像时非常有用。
sourceDefinition: Will run event.cancelable && event.preventDefault() on all events triggered by the handler. Can be useful when dragging links or images.
